comparison.command: go tool test2json -t -p room <test binary> -test.v -test.count=1 -test.timeout=6m -test.run=<generated scope>
includes: one configuration CLI build per process
one production TeamX CLI build per process
three added native protocol/lifecycle checks after migration
comparison.baseline_instrumentation: Python start/normal-exit events and identical configuration fixture setup/target/cleanup observation only; no protocol or assertion changes. Not retained in legacy Python source.
comparison.first_after_sample_note: The three added tests executed, but their per-fixture call summary was added only in the final repeat; native protocol and assertions unchanged.
limitations: Two paired local samples show substantial variance.
Fixture cumulative times overlap under four slots and are not suite wall time.
Native processing spans exclude runtime startup and may include gate waits.
Missing normal-exit events include deliberate process termination; they are not surviving-process evidence.
No claimed stable percentage or full-suite budget result.
